info.name: Get a list of threat indicator summaries based on the search criteria.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the tenancy (root compartment) that is used to filter results.

params.name: threatTypeName
params.description: The threat type of entites to be returned. To filter for multiple threat types, repeat this parameter.

params.name: type
params.description: The indicator type of entities to be returned.

params.name: value
params.description: The indicator value of entities to be returned.

params.name: confidenceGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The minimum confidence score of entities to be returned.

params.name: timeUpdatedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The oldest update time of entities to be returned.

params.name: timeUpdatedLessThan
params.description: Return indicators updated before the provided time.

params.name: timeLastSeenGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The oldest last seen time of entities to be returned.

params.name: timeLastSeenLessThan
params.description: Return indicators last seen before the provided time.

params.name: timeCreatedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The oldest created/first seen time of entities to be returned.

params.name: timeCreatedLessThan
params.description: Return indicators created/first seen before the provided time.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one field to sort by may be provided.

items.docs: Get a list of threat indicator summaries based on the search criteria.
